The '''2014–15 Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Notre Dame]] during the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Fighting Irish, led by fifteenth year head coach [[Mike Brey]], played its home games at the [[Edmund P. Joyce Center|Purcell Pavilion at the Joyce Center]] in [[South Bend, Indiana]] and were second year members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 32–6, 14–4 in ACC play to finish in third place. They defeated Miami (FL), Duke, and North Carolina to become champions of the [[2015 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]]. They received an automatic bid to the [[2015 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated Northeastern in the second round, Butler in the third round, and Wichita State in the Sweet Sixteen before losing in the Elite Eight to unbeaten [[2014–15 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]] in a close game, 68–66.

==Previous season==
The Fighting Irish finished the 2012–13 season 25–10, with an 11–7 record in Big East play. They then finished the 2013–14 season at 15–17, 6–12 in ACC play to finish in a three-way tie for 11th place. In their first year as ACC members, they lost in the first round of the [[2014 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] to Wake Forrest.
